stories.title: Quaest na BA: Lula, 58%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 23%; Augusto Cury, 4%; Ronaldo Caiado, 2%; Renan Santos, 2%

en.title: Quaest in BA: Lula, 58%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 23%; Augusto Cury, 4%; Ronaldo Caiado, 2%; Renan Santos, 2%
en.summary: A Quaest poll conducted in Bahia shows Lula leading the presidential race with 58% of voting intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 23%. Other candidates polled at 4% or lower.

stories.title: Datafolha: Marina tem 15% das intenções de voto ao Senado em SP; Tebet, 14%; Derrite e Prado, 12%

en.title: Datafolha: Marina has 15% of voting intentions for Senate in SP; Tebet, 14%; Derrite and Prado, 12%
en.summary: A Datafolha survey shows voting intentions for the Senate race in São Paulo, with Marina at 15%, Tebet at 14%, and Derrite and Prado each at 12%.

stories.title: Datafolha: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam na rejeição, com 45% cada um

en.title: Datafolha: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tie in rejection, with 45% each
en.summary: A Datafolha poll indicates that Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are equally rejected as presidential candidates, with both at 45% rejection rates. Other candidates show lower rejection levels.

stories.title: Lula tem 47% das intenções e Flávio Bolsonaro, 45%, no segundo turno, aponta pesquisa Datafolha

en.title: Lula has 47% of voting intentions and Flávio Bolsonaro, 45%, in the second round, according to Datafolha survey
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows that in a potential second-round matchup, Lula leads with 47% of voting intentions compared to Flávio Bolsonaro's 45%.

en.title: Datafolha, Second Round: Lula, 47%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 45%
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows Lula with 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 45% support in a hypothetical presidential runoff, maintaining a statistical tie from the previous week.

en.summary: A Datafolha poll indicates Lula leads with 40% in the first round of the presidential election, with Flávio Bolsonaro at 36%, a gap within the margin of error.

stories.title: Datafolha: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam em rejeição com 45%

en.title: Datafolha: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro Tied in Rejection at 45%
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro each at 45% rejection rate among Brazilian voters in the presidential race.

stories.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 40% e Flávio Bolsonaro, 36% em 1º turno; rivais empatam em 2º turno

en.summary: A Datafolha poll for the 2026 presidential race shows Lula at 40% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 36% in a first-round scenario, with the candidates tied in a hypothetical runoff.

en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows a technical tie at the top in the race for two Senate seats in Minas Gerais, with Marília Campos leading at 13% and other candidates closely trailing.

stories.title: Datafolha: Eduardo Paes (PSD) lidera com 43% das intenções de voto no Rio

en.summary: Eduardo Paes maintains his lead in Rio de Janeiro's gubernatorial race with 43%, though Douglas Ruas shows rising momentum according to a Datafolha poll.

stories.title: Datafolha: No 1º turno, Lula oscila 1 pp para cima e tem 40%, e Flávio, 36%, em empate técnico

stories.title: Lula mantém vantagem de 2 pontos sobre Flávio no 2º turno com 47% a 45%, mostra Datafolha

en.title: Lula maintains 2-point advantage over Flávio in second round with 47% to 45%, shows Datafolha
en.summary: In a potential runoff scenario, President Lula holds a two-point lead over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro at 47% to 45%, with both candidates remaining in a technical tie.

stories.title: Candidatos a deputado federal em São Paulo (SP): veja lista atualizada das eleições 2026

en.title: Federal deputy candidates in São Paulo (SP): see updated list of 2026 elections
en.summary: São Paulo has 1,132 registered candidates for federal deputy positions competing for 70 available seats in the 2026 elections scheduled for October 4. The state has over 34 million eligible voters.

en.summary: A Datafolha poll indicates a technical tie among leading candidates for two Senate seats in Minas Gerais, with Marília Campos at 13%, Aécio Neves and Carlos Viana at 11%, and Domingos Sávio at 9%.

stories.title: Datafolha: No RJ, Paes lidera com 43% das intenções de voto; Douglas Ruas tem 30%

en.title: Datafolha: In RJ, Paes leads with 43% of voting intentions; Douglas Ruas has 30%
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows former Rio mayor Eduardo Paes maintaining a lead with 43% for governor, while Douglas Ruas gained ground, rising from 25% to 30% in recent weeks.

stories.title: CMN aperta regras de investimento em créditos judiciais e arbitrais por FIDC

en.title: CMN tightens investment rules in judicial and arbitral credits by FIDC
en.summary: Brazil's Monetary Policy Council approved stricter regulations for credit rights funds investing in judicial and arbitral credits, citing concerns about multiple layers of investment funds that complicate risk assessment.

stories.title: Datafolha: Em PE, Raquel Lyra tem 48%; João Campos tem 44% no primeiro turno

en.title: Datafolha: In PE, Raquel Lyra has 48%; João Campos has 44% in first round
en.summary: A poll shows governor Raquel Lyra leading with 48% support against former Recife mayor João Campos at 44% in a Pernambuco election. The candidates remain within the margin of error and are considered technically tied.
